trans-unit.source: Modern web development and AI integration for mid-sized businesses.
trans-unit.target: Forbairt gréasáin nua-aimseartha agus comhtháthú intleachta saorga do ghnólachtaí meánmhéide.

trans-unit.source: License: GNU General Public License v2 or later.
trans-unit.target: Ceadúnas: GNU General Public License v2 nó níos déanaí.

trans-unit.source: LLM-based translation for TYPO3: profiles, glossaries, background runs.
trans-unit.target: Aistriúchán le samhail teanga do TYPO3: próifílí, gluaiseanna, rití sa chúlra.

trans-unit.source: LLM-assisted translation through the DataHandler localize path. Profiles bind sites to an LLM configuration.
trans-unit.target: Aistriúchán le samhail teanga tríd an gcosán localize sa DataHandler. Nascann próifílí suíomh le cumraíocht LLM.

trans-unit.source: The page record — title, slug and SEO metadata — is part of every run and cannot be deselected.
trans-unit.target: Tá taifead an leathanaigh — teideal, slug agus meiteashonraí SEO — mar chuid de gach rith agus ní féidir é a dhíroghnú.

trans-unit.source: Checked records are translated. An unchecked container skips its whole group; unchecked children of a checked container stay in the source language. IRRE children are translated together with their parent record.
trans-unit.target: Aistrítear na taifid atá ticeáilte. Scipeálann coimeádán gan tic an grúpa iomlán; fanann leanaí gan tic i gcoimeádán ticeáilte sa bhunteanga. Aistrítear leanaí IRRE in éineacht leis an taifead tuismitheora.

trans-unit.source: No translatable records on this page.
trans-unit.target: Níl aon taifead inaistrithe ar an leathanach seo.

trans-unit.source: Please select a page in the page tree on the left.
trans-unit.target: Roghnaigh leathanach sa chrann ar chlé.

trans-unit.source: Please choose at least one target language.
trans-unit.target: Roghnaigh sprioctheanga amháin ar a laghad.
Déanta. Tá an leathanach á athlódáil …

trans-unit.source: %s chunk(s) with errors — messages stay on screen, please check.
trans-unit.target: Codanna le hearráidí: %s — fanann na teachtaireachtaí ar an scáileán, seiceáil iad le do thoil.

trans-unit.source: Finished, with notices — messages stay on screen, please check.
trans-unit.target: Críochnaithe, le nótaí — fanann na teachtaireachtaí ar an scáileán, seiceáil iad le do thoil.

trans-unit.source: Run aborted — please check the LLM configuration.
trans-unit.target: Cuireadh deireadh leis an rith — seiceáil an chumraíocht LLM.

trans-unit.source: Please select a page (in the page tree) and at least one target language.
trans-unit.target: Roghnaigh leathanach (i gcrann na leathanach) agus sprioctheanga amháin ar a laghad.
Níl aon taifead le haistriú (rogha folamh).

trans-unit.source: Given up after %s attempts — this record kept interrupting the run. The other records were processed.
trans-unit.target: Tugadh suas i ndiaidh %s iarracht — bhí an taifead seo ag cur isteach ar an rith arís is arís eile. Próiseáladh na taifid eile.

trans-unit.source: No translation profile applies to this page. Assign the site to a profile, or leave a profile's site empty to make it the default.
trans-unit.target: Níl aon phróifíl aistriúcháin i bhfeidhm don leathanach seo. Sann an suíomh do phróifíl, nó fág suíomh próifíle folamh chun í a dhéanamh réamhshocraithe.

trans-unit.source: The source language could not be determined. Set it in the translation profile, or give the default language of the site a locale.
trans-unit.target: Níorbh fhéidir an bhunteanga a dhéanamh amach. Socraigh í sa phróifíl aistriúcháin, nó tabhair logán do theanga réamhshocraithe an tsuímh.

trans-unit.source: Run #%s queued — %s unit(s) will be processed in the background.
trans-unit.target: Cuireadh rith #%s sa scuaine — próiseálfar %s aonad sa chúlra.

trans-unit.source: A run for this page and language is already open (#%s). Please wait for it to finish or cancel it.
trans-unit.target: Tá rith ar oscailt cheana don leathanach agus don teanga seo (#%s). Fan go gcríochnóidh sé nó cealaigh é.

trans-unit.source: The run is handled by the server worker — you can close this page.
trans-unit.target: Déanann oibrí an fhreastalaí an rith — is féidir leat an leathanach seo a dhúnadh.

trans-unit.source: Records that already have a translation are left untouched; only the missing ones are created.
trans-unit.target: Fágtar taifid a bhfuil aistriúchán acu cheana gan athrú; ní chruthaítear ach na cinn atá in easnamh.

trans-unit.source: This run covers %s unit(s) in %s language(s).
trans-unit.target: Clúdaíonn an rith seo %s aonad i %s teanga.

trans-unit.source: Start this run in the browser?
trans-unit.target: An rith seo a thosú sa bhrabhsálaí?

trans-unit.source: Without "Process in the background" this page has to stay open until the run has finished. Tick that option to hand the run to the server worker instead.
trans-unit.target: Gan “Próiseáil sa chúlra” caithfidh an leathanach seo fanacht oscailte go dtí go gcríochnaíonn an rith. Tic an rogha sin chun an rith a thabhairt d’oibrí an fhreastalaí.

trans-unit.source: Run stopped: the limit of %s LLM calls was reached.
trans-unit.target: Stopadh an rith: sroicheadh an teorainn de %s ghlao LLM.

trans-unit.source: Works off the queued translation runs of the backend module. Schedule it every minute. Alternative to the console command dtranslate:work — use one or the other, not both.
trans-unit.target: Próiseálann na ritheanna aistriúcháin a chuir modúl an chúldeireadh sa scuaine. Sceidealaigh é gach nóiméad. Rogha eile ar an ordú consóil dtranslate:work — bain úsáid as ceann amháin, ná as an dá cheann.

trans-unit.source: The server did not answer for this unit (HTTP %s) — the run continues with the next one.
trans-unit.target: Níor fhreagair an freastalaí don aonad seo (HTTP %s) — leanann an rith leis an gcéad cheann eile.

trans-unit.source: Unexpected error (%s): %s — details in the TYPO3 log.
trans-unit.target: Earráid gan choinne (%s): %s — sonraí i loga TYPO3.

trans-unit.source: %s was left in the source language: the translation is longer than the field allows (%s of %s characters).
trans-unit.target: Fágadh %s sa teanga fhoinseach: tá an aistriúchán níos faide ná mar a cheadaíonn an réimse (%s as %s carachtar).

trans-unit.source: The LLM configuration "%s" has no API key. Please enter one in the configuration.
trans-unit.target: Níl eochair API ag an gcumraíocht LLM „%s”. Cuir ceann isteach sa chumraíocht.

trans-unit.source: No API key is set for the LLM configuration in use.
trans-unit.target: Níl aon eochair API socraithe don chumraíocht LLM atá in úsáid.

trans-unit.source: %s rejected the API key (HTTP %s). Please check the key in the LLM configuration and enter it again.
trans-unit.target: Dhiúltaigh %s don eochair API (HTTP %s). Seiceáil an eochair sa chumraíocht LLM agus cuir isteach arís í.

trans-unit.source: %s does not know that model or endpoint (HTTP 404). Please check the model name ("%s") and the API base URL (%s).
trans-unit.target: Níl aithne ag %s ar an tsamhail nó ar an gcríochphointe sin (HTTP 404). Seiceáil ainm na samhla („%s”) agus bun-URL an API (%s).

trans-unit.source: %s declined the request because of a rate limit (HTTP 429).
trans-unit.target: Dhiúltaigh %s don iarratas mar gheall ar theorainn ráta (HTTP 429).

trans-unit.source: The quota of the %s account is used up (HTTP %s). Please check billing and credit.
trans-unit.target: Tá cuóta an chuntais %s ídithe (HTTP %s). Seiceáil an billeáil agus an t-iarmhéid.

trans-unit.source: %s rejected the request (HTTP %s) — usually an unknown model name ("%s") or an unsupported parameter.
trans-unit.target: Dhiúltaigh %s don iarratas (HTTP %s) — de ghnáth ainm samhla anaithnid („%s”) nó paraiméadar nach dtacaítear leis.

trans-unit.source: %s reports a malfunction (HTTP %s). Please try again later.
trans-unit.target: Tuairiscíonn %s fadhb (HTTP %s). Bain triail eile as ar ball.

trans-unit.source: "%s" cannot be reached. Please check the API base URL of the LLM configuration. (%s)
trans-unit.target: Ní féidir „%s” a bhaint amach. Seiceáil bun-URL an API sa chumraíocht LLM. (%s)

trans-unit.source: Timeout on the request to %s — the provider did not answer in time.
trans-unit.target: Imithe thar am leis an iarratas chuig %s — níor fhreagair an soláthraí in am.
Níor sheol %s JSON bailí ar ais.
